name: JETSON
recent: Kumpulan Jetson 完成了最高 10% 的私募配售，分三批发行新股，最后一批于 2026 年 9 月 14 日上市。公司 2026 财年审计报告出现与持续经营相关的保留意见，并有一项重大诉讼待披露。第 49 届常年股东大会定于 2026 年 12 月 11 日举行。
notable: 完成最高 10% 的私募配售，三批新股均已上市，最后一批 7,507,000 股于 2026 年 9 月 14 日上市。
2026 财年审计报告获核数师发出保留意见，并提及与持续经营相关的重大不确定性。
有一项重大诉讼的公告。
risks: 私募配售分三批发行新股，最高占已发行股份 10%，对现有股东持股有摊薄影响。
核数师对 2026 财年财报发出保留意见，并提及持续经营重大不确定性。
公司涉及一项重大诉讼。
earnings: 最近一期财报（截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 48,027,000，净亏损 MYR 3,186,000，净利率 -6.6%，较上一期的 -3.1% 扩大；营收环比增长 8.7%。

recent_en: Kumpulan Jetson completed a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares in three tranches, with the final tranche listed on 14 September 2026. The company's FY2026 audit report carries a qualified opinion with material uncertainty related to going concern, and a material litigation is ongoing. Its 49th AGM is scheduled for 11 December 2026.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of up to 10% of issued shares in three tranches, with the final 7,507,000 shares listed on 14 September 2026.
The FY2026 audit report carries a qualified opinion with material uncertainty related to going concern.
A material litigation announcement was made.
risks_en: The private placement issued new shares in three tranches for up to 10% of issued shares, diluting existing shareholders.
The auditor issued a qualified opinion on the FY2026 financial statements with material uncertainty related to going concern.
The company is involved in a material litigation.
earnings_en: For the latest reported period ended 30 September 2025, revenue was MYR 48,027,000 with a net loss of MYR 3,186,000, a net margin of -6.6% versus -3.1% previously; revenue rose 8.7% quarter-on-quarter.
